description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayLaunchAgentManager, focusing on parsing plist files to extract configuration such as port, bind address, token, and password. It verifies correct parsing behavior in different scenarios.

classes.name: GatewayLaunchAgentManagerTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests for GatewayLaunchAgentManager, specifically testing plist snapshot parsing.
